# Research

::: sub
**Quantitative Ecology · Conservation Bioacoustics · Ornithology**

## **Passive acoustic monitoring of urban bird communities.**
:::

I study how bird communities respond to urban development across
Stockton, California. Using passive acoustic monitoring and machine
learning-based species identification, I am estimating species richness
and occupancy in relation to vegetation structure and urban land use.

The Central Valley is one of North America’s most altered landscapes,
having lost most of its historic wetlands, riparian forests, and
grasslands. Those losses have contributed to widespread declines of
habitat-specialist birds. This region also forms a large part of the
Pacific Flyway bird migration route, so the habitat that remains is
especially important for sustaining migratory species.

Species distributions are rarely resolved within a single city, so my
project is producing localized data that citywide greening initiatives
can act on.
